keyEvents.text: Federico Pereira (Toluca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Federico Viñas (Toluca).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Club América 0, Toluca 1. Federico Viñas (Toluca) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Helinho following a fast break.
Jesús Gallardo (Toluca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Club América. Cristián Borja replaces Franco Rossano.
Substitution, Club América. Miguel Borja replaces Isaías Violante.
Substitution, Toluca. Everardo López replaces Jorge Díaz.
Goal! Club América 1, Toluca 1. Henry Martín (Club América) left footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal.
Substitution, Toluca. Alexis Vega replaces Helinho.
Substitution, Toluca. Érick Gutiérrez replaces Fernando Arce.
Delay in match (Club América).
Delay in match because of an injury Bruno Méndez (Toluca).
Substitution, Toluca. Jesús Angulo replaces Nicolás Castro.
Substitution, Toluca. Paulinho replaces Bruno Méndez because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Luis García (Toluca).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Club América. Alexis Gutiérrez replaces Carlos Álvarez.
Santiago Bueno (Club América) is shown the red card.
Penalty saved. Alexis Vega (Toluca) right footed shot saved in the centre of the goal by Luis Malagón (Club América).
Goal! Club América 1, Toluca 2. Alexis Vega (Toluca) header from very close range to the centre of the goal following a set piece situation.
Second yellow card to Federico Pereira (Toluca).
Goal! Club América 2, Toluca 2. Henry Martín (Club América) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the top right corner.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Israel Reyes (Club América) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Club América. Alan Cervantes replaces Henry Martín.
Miguel Borja (Club América) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Érick Sánchez (Club América) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Club América 2, Toluca 2.
